title: Net direct tax collections rise 11.8% to ₹14.42 trillion as of November 10
hook: Direct tax collections climb 11.8% to ₹14.42 trillion
points: Net direct tax collections reached ₹14.42 trillion as of November 10.
That is an 11.8% rise over the same point last year.
why: Stronger direct tax receipts give the Centre more room to meet its fiscal deficit target without cutting capital spending.

title: RBI to conduct 3-day Variable Rate Reverse Repo (VRRR) auction under LAF on November 13, 2026
hook: RBI moves to absorb surplus liquidity with a 3-day VRRR auction
points: The RBI will hold a 3-day variable rate reverse repo auction on November 13.
The operation sits under the Liquidity Adjustment Facility (LAF).
why: Draining excess cash keeps overnight rates close to the policy corridor and signals how the RBI reads system liquidity.

title: UPI volume jumps 32% on Diwali driven by last-minute festival buying
hook: UPI volumes jump 32% on Diwali as festive buying peaks
points: UPI transaction volumes rose 32% on Diwali.
Last-minute festival shopping drove the spike.
why: Festive digital payments are a real-time read on household consumption ahead of official data.

title: Cabinet clears ₹2,390 crore Noida Metro Aqua Line expansion over 8.5 km
hook: Cabinet approves ₹2,390 crore, 8.5 km Noida Metro extension
points: The Union Cabinet cleared the Aqua Line expansion at ₹2,390 crore.
The extension adds 8.5 km to the Noida Metro network.
why: Urban transit capex supports construction demand now and productivity gains in the NCR over time.

title: Piero Cipollone: Cash and the digital euro: two sides of the same coin
hook: ECB's Cipollone pitches the digital euro as a partner to cash, not a replacement
points: ECB Executive Board member Piero Cipollone spoke on cash and the digital euro.
He framed the two as complementary forms of central bank money.
why: A digital euro could shape how other central banks, including the RBI with its e-rupee, design retail CBDCs.

title: Federal Reserve announces revised tentative schedule of Federal Open Market Committee meetings in 2027
hook: US Fed publishes revised 2027 FOMC meeting calendar
points: The Federal Reserve released a revised tentative schedule of 2027 FOMC meetings.
why: Fed decision dates move global rates and capital flows, so Indian markets and the RBI track them closely.
